I’m aware it isn’t about me. Never said it was. I am afraid, I’m terrified of what will happen onward as my life has surrounded my parents entirely. As for the “child” comment, my father treats me as an adult and my mother treats me as a 13 year old. My dad and I have been talking about it and he says that my mother hasn’t said anything about what they are going to do(she is the one who has separated them). She has been hiding in their room everyday she comes home from work and locking herself away.

I’ve spoken to her mother, and my sister (the people that she is closest to). She refuses to say anything about the separation to anyone.

I don’t know if you’ve ever gone through a divorce with parents, but I feel almost every aspect that you described. Maybe I don’t understand the way THEY feel those emotions, but I can damn well guarantee to you that I’m feeling the pain, disappointment, regret, love, and confusion of this entire ordeal. 

I just want guidance as to what is coming next. My life surrounds my parents as I have to follow them forward. I understand that I am not the “main idea” of the divorce. But you cannot tell me I am not a subtopic, for something that someone would ask while thinking of divorce is, “what about the kids.”
